prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1404; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows scraping and a dented, creased rear quarter panel on the passenger side, with a cracked taillight lens and paint transfer along the lower door. The pattern of damage lines up with the sideswipe described during the lane change, and nothing on the car points to a different cause. The repair plan calls for replacing the rear quarter panel, refinishing the adjoining door, and swapping the taillight assembly, with labor hours that fit the work involved. The shop's invoices list each item once with no repeated charges. We have no record or sign of earlier damage to this vehicle in the same area, so the repair scope can be approved as written.
